Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class SldBuilder.RasterBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldBuilder.RasterBuilder
Enclosing class:
SldBuilder
public static final class SldBuilder.RasterBuilder extends Object
Full-featured builder for a <RasterSymbolizer>. Supports ChannelSelection, ContrastEnhancement, OverlapBehavior, ColorMap, ShadedRelief, and ImageOutline.

Obtain via SldBuilder.RuleBuilder.rasterBuilder(). Call end() to return to the rule. 


 SldBuilder.create("dem").rule()
     .rasterBuilder()
         .opacity(0.9)
         .channelGray("1")
         .contrastEnhancement(ContrastMethod.NORMALIZE)
         .overlapBehavior(OverlapBehavior.LATEST_ON_TOP)
         .colorMap(SldColorMapType.RAMP,
                   SldColorMapEntry.of("#0000FF", 0, "Low"),
                   SldColorMapEntry.of("#FF0000", 100, "High"))
         .shadedRelief(55, false)
     .end().build();
Since:
1.0.0
